title: agent-meter usage event v1
description: One cumulative session snapshot pushed by a coding-harness reporter. Counts are running totals for the session, not deltas. An unknown count is null, never 0. input_tokens excludes cache read and cache write; each harness normalizes that before sending. The document must not carry prompts, messages, tool input or output, diffs, or file paths inside a repo. agent-meterd rejects unknown keys. This file is the contract for agent-setup#140 and #141-#143.

idempotency_key.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string host|harness|session_id|seq. seq is decimal with no leading zeros (seq 0 is "0"). host, harness, and session_id contain no '|' character.

host.description: Reporter host id. For HTTP ingest this must equal the host id of the bearer token.

harness.description: Stable lowercase harness id: claude, codex, agy, grok, muse, omp, copilot, cursor, gemini.

harness_version.description: CLI version that produced the snapshot. Send "unknown" when the reporter cannot read it. Do not omit the field.

session_id.description: Stable session id from the harness. Not a filesystem path.

seq.description: Monotonic snapshot counter for this session. The store keeps the highest seq. Bump seq whenever the cumulative totals change. Repeated Stop hooks with the same seq are duplicates.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp with a numeric offset when the reporter observed the snapshot.

models.description: Full set of models for this session so far. Replaces the previous snapshot; it is not a delta.

source.description: Short origin tag such as hook:Stop+transcript. Not a transcript, prompt, or path.

dispatch_run_id.description: Optional dispatch-launch run id for a later join. Null when the session was not launched by dispatch.

repo.description: Repository slug owner/name, or null. Not a filesystem path and not a file inside the repo.

model.description: Model id as reported by the harness, for example claude-opus-5-5.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens excluding cache read and cache write. Null when the harness did not report this count. Never coerce unknown to 0.

cost_usd.description: USD cost for this model in the session so far. Null when the harness has no cost figure.

cost_source.description: harness: the CLI reported the cost. estimated: the reporter priced tokens. none: cost_usd is null.
